text: Initially, I was skeptical about this app, thinking it might not be able to capture my dictation. However, as I use it more and more on a daily basis, it has helped to capture whatever my brain is thinking and then refine it. Also, working in a fast-paced environment, I don't really have the time to actually stand and type my message. This has helped me to ensure that I get information out as quickly and as accurately as possible.
